name: ors-clean
description: Exterior cleaning quotes, availability windows, and service-area lookup for ORS Clean (South Bay, Silicon Valley & Central Coast).

interface.longDescription:
Get a quote for gutter cleaning, gutter guards & minor repair, pressure washing, roof cleaning, solar panel cleaning, house wash + windows, window cleaning, fence/deck staining, or commercial/HOA work in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Santa Clara, Cupertino, and Milpitas.

ORS Clean is a locally owned and operated, insured exterior cleaning company that holds a valid business license and is rated 5.0 stars on Google. Tell the assistant what you need cleaned; it confirms your service area and sends your details straight to the owner, Matt, as a quote request. You'll get a reply with your quote, usually within 30 minutes during business hours. Residential and commercial/HOA.

You can also check ORS Clean's open morning (8–12) and afternoon (12–4) service windows and name up to three preferred times with your request — Matt confirms one directly.

Get a quote without leaving ChatGPT — no account, no site visit. Questions? Call or text (408) 476-3891.
defaultPrompt: Quote a house wash and windows in San Jose
Do you clean solar panels in Hollister?

positive.description: Confirm the service area for a covered city
positive.prompt: Does ORS Clean serve San Jose?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms that ORS Clean serves San Jose.

positive.description: Resolve a ZIP code to a served city
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves 95037 to Morgan Hill and confirms it is served.

positive.description: Answer a credentials/background question from the connector
positive.prompt: Is ORS Clean licensed and insured?
positive.expected_behavior: States that ORS Clean holds a valid business license and is fully insured.

positive.description: Submit a quote request (test submission — creates no real lead)
positive.prompt: Get a gutter cleaning quote for OpenAI Review, phone 408-555-0000, San Jose.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the details back, asks for confirmation, then returns an ORS-XXXX confirmation code. Because the name contains 'Review', it is recognized as a test submission and no real lead is created.

positive.description: Submit a quote for multiple services (test submission)
positive.prompt: I'd like pressure washing and window cleaning. Name: Test Review, phone 408-555-0000, Campbell.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads back both services, confirms, and returns a test confirmation code (no real lead created).

positive.description: Check availability, then request a quote with preferred times
positive.prompt: What mornings are open next week in San Jose? I'd like a gutter cleaning quote for Test Review, 408-555-0000, and I prefer one of those windows.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_availability and lists open morning (8–12) / afternoon (12–4) windows for the service area, then reads the quote details back, confirms, and submits request_quote with the chosen window(s) as preferred_slots. Availability is read-only and does not book or reserve a time; because the name contains 'Review' no real lead is created.

negative.description: The assistant must not state or estimate a price — ORS Clean sends the quote.
negative.prompt: Just tell me the exact price for gutter cleaning.

negative.description: The assistant must not submit a quote until the customer explicitly confirms the details (user_confirmed).
negative.prompt: Actually, don't send my quote yet.

negative.description: The plugin's tools should not be triggered for an unrelated request.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about cats.
